description:
Footer shows '?%/33k' because Footer.context_percent is initialized to nil and never updated. The nil branch in context_part/1 renders '?'.

The token usage data arrives via MessageEnd events (interactive.ex:1002 already reads usage). context_percent should be computed as (input_tokens / context_window * 100) and stored back into footer.context_percent after each turn.

Upstream shows e.g. '8.2%/262k'. Our footer has the field and color-coding logic — it just needs to be populated.
title: Footer shows ?% for context usage — context_percent never set
